payload.title: Object-level site authorization grants tenant-wide site scope to any holder of the global MODULE_MANAGER role, so a sensor or HR manager bypasses farm site restrictions in SiteAuthorizationService, assertSelfOrManager and four inline checks in farm water-quality and feeding code
evidence: libs/backend-common/src/security/site-authorization.service.ts:67-73 (resolveSiteScope returns TENANT for any role at or above MODULE_MANAGER)
libs/backend-common/src/security/assert-self-scope.ts:62-67 (the owner-or-manager bypass uses the same global-role test)
apps/farm-service/src/water-quality/water-quality.service.ts:240-243 (assertUnitsSiteAuthorized skips site checks for a global manager)
apps/farm-service/src/water-quality/services/measurement-point-lookup.ts:127-130 (readsEverySite is decided from the global role)
apps/farm-service/src/feeding-protocol/resolvers/meal-execution.resolver.ts:81-83 (the day-plan read widens on the global role)
apps/farm-service/src/feeding-protocol/resolvers/feed-forecast.resolver.ts:76-78 (the forecast read widens on the global role)
payload.rule_violated: The plan's decided default (a site assignment is a physical restriction in every module where the user is MODULE_USER) and the PKG-02 rule that the global role never grants module access.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-08, release R4.
